faqs.question: What is this product?
faqs.answer: It contains creatine, a compound commonly found in the body and widely used to support strength, recovery, and performance, combined with electrolytes to help support hydration and fluid balance.

faqs.question: Who should take it?
faqs.answer: Creatine supplementation can be beneficial for most individuals. It is especially useful for those with an active lifestyle, with electrolytes supporting hydration during daily activities and workouts.

faqs.question: Are there any side effects?
faqs.answer: There are no known side effects when used as directed. It is recommended to maintain adequate daily water intake, considering both creatine and electrolyte intake.

faqs.question: How long should I take it to see improvements?
faqs.answer: For best results, consistent use for up to 3 months is recommended.

faqs.question: How much should I have?
faqs.answer: Use as per the recommended serving mentioned on the packaging.

reviews.author: Prayag Rane
reviews.title: Product that has changed my life!
reviews.body: I was skeptical to use the product first but I am glad I did. This has helped me stay consistent with my workouts, I feel energised everyday to go out there and give my best!

reviews.author: Sarvesh Goel
reviews.title: Taste + Recovery... A supplement I wouldn't shy away from taking daily!
reviews.body: Never thought supplements could taste this good! Electrolytes and creatine in one supplement that too with such a great taste!

reviews.author: Satwik Kadam
reviews.title: A Must have for Runners!
reviews.body: I wasn't sure whether I should take this at first as I don't want to get bulky muscles, but now that I have started using it, I wonder why didn't I start it sooner!Creatine really doesn't make you bulky, rather it has helped me improve my endurance and performance in runs and now I don't even jave to take electrolytes separately.

reviews.author: Shree Sharma
reviews.title: My constant for every marathon!
reviews.body: This has become my go to supplement for every marathon! I feel so energised and hydrated with this that it boosts my confidence during the races
